_about: Task 2: what an operator's own picture must be like, shown next to the upload box (GET /api/i23d/spec). $-placeholders come from config/defaults.yaml i23d.upload (string.Template).
rules: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to $max_mb MB. Shortest side $good_side px or more ($min_side px is the minimum).
One object, whole and not cropped: nothing touching the edge of the picture.
Plain and in a different colour from the object. A PNG with a transparent background is best.
Three-quarter view from slightly above (about 20° up, 35° round), like the stage examples.
Even and soft. No hard shadows, glare or strong reflections: they get painted into the texture.
Glass and see-through objects, mirrors, thin wires or hair, text-heavy surfaces, people, and scenes with several objects.
